name: Pyroclastic density current
description: PHIVOLCS reported a pyroclastic density current down the slopes of Mayon after part of a lava flow collapsed from the summit crater, followed by light ashfall in parts of Albay.
source_name: Philippine Daily Inquirer via Asia News Network, citing PHIVOLCS

name: Moderately explosive eruption
description: PHIVOLCS raised Mayon to Alert Level 3 after an eruption at 11:53 AM.
